description: Starts a test run of a chat, voice or phone caller suite exactly as it is configured in the product UI: every scenario of the suite, with its voices and personas. A chat or voice suite runs on HyperExecute against a saved endpoint profile: the project default unless endpointProfile is given, and when the project has several profiles and no default it refuses and lists them. A phone caller suite PLACES REAL PHONE CALLS to the number saved with the suite and takes no endpoint profile; suites that test an outbound phone agent are started from the product UI. Every run uses account credits. It creates and edits nothing, cannot run a single scenario, and refuses when the suite has no scenarios. Returns a job or run id; agent_testing_get_results shows progress and the outcome. Image analyser projects cannot be run.

endpointProfile.description: Chat and voice only: endpoint profile ID or exact name to run against. Defaults to the project default.

name: agent_testing_run_suite
title: Run Agent Testing Suite
